governance.note: The ownership conclusions had already been incorporated into research synthesis text before this formal result record was created. This file is a source-bound reconciliation record, not prospective validation.

current_fgc_head_object.source_statement: mod_modflow6_swap_prescribed_qbot_bottom_face.f90 explicitly states that the derived head is the coupling-plane head and is not the freatic groundwater level
current_fgc_head_object.predictor_mapping: bottom-node state plus Darcy half-cell extrapolation -> bottom-face pressure head -> interface hydraulic head
current_fgc_head_object.corrector_mapping: interface hydraulic head -> SWAP bottom pressure head -> forcing.bottom_head

swap_state_separation.implication: The fixture stores a groundwater_level state separately from the coupling-plane interface head. The head-forcing adapter writes bottom_head and does not establish equality with the groundwater_level field.

modflow_fixture_storage.grid: 1 layer x 1 row x 3 columns; top=0 m, bottom=-2 m; cell area 1 m2
modflow_fixture_storage.note: These are explicit MODFLOW fixture parameters.

swap_fixture_storage_domain.physical_state: pressure_head and water_content are SWAP/FMR-owned state; groundwater_level is separately initialized
swap_fixture_storage_domain.note: No source authority declares this FMR storage domain to be geometrically or constitutively identical to the MODFLOW STO cell volume.

coupling_storage_ownership.api_role: F-GC33/API supplies an affine HCOF/RHS response; it does not itself configure or replace the MODFLOW STO package
coupling_storage_ownership.fixture_role: F-GC45 and F-GC49D qualification fixtures intentionally allow MODFLOW STO and nonzero SWAP response u to coexist
coupling_storage_ownership.conclusion: Coexistence in these synthetic qualification fixtures does not establish duplicate physical storage and does not establish a valid shared-storage partition.

bounded_conclusions: The current F-GC route is not demonstrated to be a phreatic shared-state h-link. Its explicit exchanged state is a lower coupling-plane hydraulic head.
The current F-GC fixture therefore cannot be used as direct evidence that SWAP finite-window storage response and MODFLOW STO describe the same physical volume.

MAP03/MAP10 establish that u_A can be a finite-window whole-column SWAP storage sensitivity in drainage-free cases, but MAP11 prevents reinterpreting that fact as a MODFLOW-STO double-counting result without a separate domain-equivalence authority.
A future true phreatic h-link design would need an explicit common-state and storage-ownership contract rather than inheriting it from the present lower-boundary interface formulation.
forbidden_inference: Do not call F-GC45 a duplicate-storage proof.
Do not call the present lower coupling-plane head a freatic water-table state.
Do not infer that MODFLOW STO is correct, incorrect, complementary or duplicated for a real deployment until the real coupled-domain ownership is specified.
Do not change production F-GC code from this audit.
next: Close MAP09 active-drainage prescribed-head feasibility and MAP09A only if its activation rule is satisfied.
For any real deployment architecture, define the geometric and constitutive ownership of MODFLOW storage relative to the SWAP column before judging storage overlap.
